asset.name: Timesheet decision
asset.description: Sent to the employee when their timesheet is approved or rejected.
asset.subject: Timesheet for week ending {{form.week_ending}}: {{decision}}
asset.html_body:
Timesheet {{decision}}

Hi {{form.employee_name}},

Your timesheet for the week ending {{=FORMAT_DATE(form.week_ending, "DD/MM/YYYY")}} on {{form.project}} ({{client}}) was {{decision}}.

Mon–Fri{{form.mon}} · {{form.tue}} · {{form.wed}} · {{form.thu}} · {{form.fri}}
Total{{total_hours}} h ({{overtime_hours}} h overtime)

Comment: {{approver_comment}}

{{=IF(decision = "rejected", "Please correct it and submit the timesheet again.", "")}}

Reference {{timesheet_ref}} · sent by the timesheet approval workflow
asset.text_body: Your timesheet for the week ending {{form.week_ending}} ({{form.project}}, {{total_hours}} h) was {{decision}}. Comment: {{approver_comment}}. Reference {{timesheet_ref}}.
